images.label: Scabies
images.description: Human scabies is an intensely pruritic skin infestation caused by the host-specific mite Sarcoptes scabiei hominis. The mites reproduce on the skin surface and then burrow into the skin and lay eggs. This causes a pruritic, red skin rash. Scabies occurs worldwide and affects people of all races and social classes.
